description.zh:
可见性。可取值：
- PUBLIC：工作空间内公开可见
- PRIVATE：仅创建者可见
description.en:
Visibility of the connection. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: visible to all workspace members.

- PRIVATE: visible only to the creator.
List of connection IDs to filter by.
List of connection types to filter by.
Alibaba Cloud account ID of the creator.

description.zh:
加密设置。可取值：
- PlainText（明文）
- Secret（密文）
description.en:
Encryption option for sensitive fields in the response. Valid values:

- PlainText: returns values in plaintext.

- Secret: returns values in ciphertext.
Maximum number of entries per page.
Model identifier. Filters connections associated with this model.
List of model types to filter by.

description.zh: 分页游标的标识。用于标记下一页查询的起始位置。
description.en: The token that marks the starting position for the next page of results.

description.zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序，与SortBy结合使用。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC（默认值）：降序。
description.en:
Sort order. Use with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC (default): descending order.

description.zh:
分页查询时的排序字段，默认使用GmtCreateTime。取值如下。
- GmtCreateTime（默认值）：按创建时间。
description.en:
Field by which to sort results. Default value: GmtCreateTime. Valid values:

- GmtCreateTime (default): sorts by creation time.

description.zh:
是否支持ToolCall工具调用。可取值：
- true：支持
- false：不支持
description.en:
Whether tool calling is supported. Valid values:

- true: supported.

- false: not supported.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: Workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
